silk_gated.short: needs silk touch to recover the block itself
silk_gated.long: Without Silk Touch, stone gives cobble and glass gives nothing at all. Off: only blocks that drop themselves with any tool.

gravity.long: Sand and gravel fall when the block beneath them goes missing. Off: kept out of your palette entirely.

support_mandatory.long: Vanilla pops carpets and pressure plates off if nothing is underneath, however you place them, so the schematic adds filler. Off: only blocks that stand on their own.

unstable.short: changes over time once placed (grass, ice, unwaxed copper, coral)
unstable.long: Grass spreads and unwaxed copper oxidizes, so the map drifts away from what you built. Off: only blocks that stay exactly as placed.

constrained.short: needs a specific substrate/neighbor to stay placed
constrained.long: Wheat needs farmland and kelp needs water. Plain filler will not hold either. Off: only blocks that sit on anything.

flammable.long: Fire spreads through wool and wood. Matters if the build sits near lava or in the Nether. Off: nothing that burns.

unrecoverable.short: no way to get this block back with your current tools
unrecoverable.long: Your loadout has no way to get these back when you tear the map down, so you would be spending them permanently. Off: hide them.

class_match_only.gloss: only blocks my tools are made for
class_match_only.short: your loadout has no tool of the class this block wants
class_match_only.long: For strict palettes such as silk pick only. Hides anything your loadout carries no matching tool for, even where you could still break it slowly. On: a pickaxe-only palette really is pickaxe-only.
